verdict.rationale: Drata's own docs show a Monitoring Tests capability: an API to list, create custom, get and update tests, a training video titled 'Understanding Monitoring in Drata', connections to systems, and an agent that checks endpoint security settings. A community comment confirms that noncompliance shows up in the Drata dashboard. However, the evidence is mostly page titles and endpoint names, and nothing states how often tests run or how quickly failures surface. missing for 10: documented continuous/hourly test cadence, evidence that failing controls surface within hours, alerting on failed tests, in-depth first-party monitoring docs beyond titles, independent hands-on corroboration of detection speed

support.subject: As a security engineer, automated tests run continuously against my connected systems — failing controls surface within hours, not at the annual audit
